test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Constitutional Amendment explicitly inserted the term 'Cabinet' into the Indian Constitution in the context of Article 352?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978** explicitly added the term "**Cabinet**" to Article 352 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• This amendment was introduced to ensure that the decision to impose a **National Emergency** under Article 352 is made collectively by the **entire Cabinet**, rather than solely by the Prime Minister.
 
• The term "**Cabinet**" was defined under Article 352 to mean the **Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.**
 
• It was a significant reform to curb potential misuse of emergency provisions, following the experiences during the **Emergency period (1975-77).**
 
• Prior to this amendment, there was no explicit requirement for the **Cabinet's concurrence** before proclaiming a National Emergency.
 
• The 44th Amendment is considered one of the most important amendments to strengthen **democratic safeguards** and prevent authoritarian misuse of constitutional provisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976**__

 __
 
• Often referred to as the "**Mini Constitution**", it made extensive changes to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It gave primacy to the **Directive Principles of State Policy** over Fundamental Rights.
 
• The amendment also added the words "**Socialist**" and "**Secular**" to the Preamble.
 
• It curtailed the powers of the **judiciary** and made the Constitution more **centralized.**
 
 
 
• **43rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1977**__
 __
 
• It was enacted to restore the powers of the **judiciary** that were curtailed by the 42nd Amendment.
 
• It removed some of the provisions introduced by the 42nd Amendment that were deemed undemocratic.
 
 
 
• **45th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1980**__
 
 
• This amendment extended the reservation of seats for **Scheduled Castes** and **Scheduled Tribes** in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies for another ten years.
